title: fix(kanban): lanes on a lookup or user field key by the foreign key and are titled by the record's name (#36430)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8722AKp5es9SqH3bShhXVa1)_

Card thread for #36430, dispatched by seat repo:objectstack#1 · session_01JQwxba2NAjVpDLao1M9SYN

Fixes #36430 (items 1–3; item 4 is open, see below)

## 维护者速读

- 看板按「负责人」这类查找 / 人员 / 主从 / 树形字段分列时，原来画出一堆标题为「[object Object]」的列、每列塞满全部卡片。现在每个被引用的记录一列，列名是它的名字（人名、客户名），卡片各归各列，没有值的卡片在「未分类」。
- 把卡片拖到另一列，会把该字段改成那一列对应的记录（例如把负责人从 Alice 改成 Bob），卡片上的负责人名字也随之更新。
- 第 4 项（在「视图设置 → 分列字段」里提供这些字段）还没做：它在列表视图的设置面板里，等维护者确认后补上，否则由席位另立卡。

## What changes

`ui/packages/plugin-kanban` only.

1. **Lanes from a reference field** — `ObjectKanban#effectiveColumns`' data-derived branch built lanes from `String(record[groupBy])`. The board fetches with `$expand`, so a reference value is the referenced record and every lane was `"[object Object]"`. New `kanbanReferenceLanes.ts`: `lanesFromRecords` makes one lane per distinct key — the expanded record's `id` (`_id`), else the stored value — titled through core's `referencedRecordTitle` (the field's `displayField`, then the target object's `nameField`, then the shared ladder), else the key. When the lane field declares `reference`, the board reads that object's definition (`useSettledSchema`, cached) so its declared name field titles the lane. A record with no value names no lane (it was already bucketed to "Uncategorized"; before, a data-derived board also drew an empty lane titled `null`).
2. **Bucketing on the foreign key** — `bucketCardsIntoColumns` keys a record by `laneKeyOf(value)`, so expanded references land in their lane, including declared `columns` keyed by foreign key. Lane paging already filters each lane's query on the lane id (the key), unchanged.
3. **A drag writes the foreign key** — the PATCH already sends the lane id, which is now the key. The optimistic local row holds the target lane's expanded record (`laneValueOf`) instead of the bare key, so the card keeps naming its new owner; the failure rollback restores the expanded value it held.

**Item 4 (lane-field picker) is not in this diff.** It lives in `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (`laneFieldOptions` filter); the seat widened the surface, and the edit is waiting on the maintainer's go-ahead in the thread.

## Why

A board grouped by owner is a common grouping and was unusable (#36430, graded p1).

## Verification

Head `02acbeab`, tree `objectstack-ai/objectstack@02acbeab`:

- New `ObjectKanban.referenceLanes-36430.test.tsx` (4 rows: owner lanes titled by name with the right cards; lookup lane titled by the target's `nameField`; a drop writes `{ owner_id: 'u2' }` and the card stays in Bob's lane; declared FK-keyed lanes take expanded values) and two rows in `index.bucket.test.ts`.
- Ablation: with `ObjectKanban.tsx` and `index.tsx` restored from `origin/main` and the tests kept, 5 of the new rows fail (all 4 board rows and the FK bucketing row); with the fix, all pass.
- `vitest run packages/plugin-kanban/` on `d8058107` (the later head only adds changeset lines): 84 files, 552 tests passed.
- `overlap-check.mjs`: clean against `origin/main` `d7411fa3` and 0 open PR heads.
- NOT MEASURED locally: `type-check` for plugin-kanban (the `@object-ui/*` dependency declarations are not built in this container; every error printed was a missing-module / implicit-any cascade, none on the new code's logic). `Type Check UI` in CI is the verdict.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Acceptance notes

- **Item 4 and the swimlane sibling.** If the maintainer has not approved item 4 by the time CI is green, the seat (repo:objectstack#1) files two follow-up cards and lands this PR with `Fixes #36430` covering items 1–3:
  - the lane-field picker offering single-valued lookup, user, master-detail and tree fields (`ListView.tsx` `laneFieldOptions`), item 4 of #36430;
  - a swimlane (`swimlaneField`) on a reference field, which still stringifies the value in `KanbanImpl`'s swimlane bucketing (same defect class, the other axis).
- A multi-valued reference used as the lane field still draws `[object Object],…` lanes; the picker change for item 4 leaves multi-valued references out.
